evidence.quote: Mesa Verde Contractors, Inc.
evidence.rationale: The preamble identifies Mesa Verde Contractors, Inc. as "Contractor".

evidence.quote: Lumen Electric Corp.
evidence.rationale: The preamble identifies Lumen Electric Corp. as "Subcontractor".

evidence.quote: Washoe County School District
evidence.rationale: The recital names Washoe County School District as "Owner".

evidence.quote: Sparks Middle School Gymnasium Addition
evidence.rationale: The recital names the Project.

evidence.quote: This Subcontract is governed by the laws of the State of Nevada
evidence.rationale: Section 17.1 selects Nevada law.

evidence.quote: Contractor and Subcontractor expressly agree in writing that Contractor's payment obligation under this Section 5.3 is a pay-when-paid term
evidence.rationale: Section 5.3 measures payment timing from Contractor's receipt of Owner payment and expressly labels it pay-when-paid. It does not state a condition precedent.

evidence.quote: Contractor shall pay Subcontractor each progress payment within ten (10) days after Contractor receives payment from Owner for the Subcontract Work covered by that payment.
evidence.rationale: Section 5.3 states ten days.

evidence.quote: Contractor and Subcontractor expressly agree in writing that Contractor's payment obligation under this Section 5.3 is a pay-when-paid term
evidence.rationale: A specific 10-day period is written into Section 5.3, and the parties expressly agree to it in writing.

evidence.quote: Contractor shall retain five percent (5%) of each progress payment otherwise due to Subcontractor as retainage.
evidence.rationale: Section 6.1 sets retainage at 5%, which is 500 bps.

release_condition.value: upon both (a) Final Completion of the Subcontract Work and (b) Contractor's receipt of retention from Owner

evidence.quote: Retainage shall be released to Subcontractor upon both (a) Final Completion of the Subcontract Work and (b) Contractor's receipt of retention from Owner.
evidence.rationale: Section 6.2 states the two-part trigger. Section 6.3 adds delivery of closeout deliverables and final waivers. Final Completion as defined requires deliverables to be accepted by Contractor.

evidence.quote: Contractor shall pay the retainage to Subcontractor within ten (10) days after the later of those two events.
evidence.rationale: Section 6.2 states ten days after the later of the two events.

evidence.quote: With each Application for Payment, Subcontractor shall deliver a Conditional Waiver and Release Upon Progress Payment, in the form prescribed by NRS 108.2457, covering the full amount requested.
evidence.rationale: Section 7.2 requires a conditional waiver with each application.

evidence.quote: Within five (5) days after receiving each progress payment, Subcontractor shall deliver an Unconditional Waiver and Release Upon Progress Payment, in the form prescribed by NRS 108.2457, covering the amount actually received.
evidence.rationale: Section 7.3 requires an unconditional waiver after each payment.

evidence.quote: Subcontractor shall obtain and deliver to Contractor, with each Application for Payment and with its application for final payment, conditional and unconditional waivers from each of its lower-tier subcontractors and suppliers whose work or materials are included in the payment
evidence.rationale: Section 7.5 requires waivers from lower-tier subcontractors and suppliers.

evidence.quote: All waivers and releases required by this Article shall be in the forms prescribed by NRS 108.2457.
evidence.rationale: Section 7.1 requires the Nevada statutory forms under NRS 108.2457 and rejects other states' forms.

evidence.quote: Contractor may set off against any payment due to Subcontractor under this Subcontract the amount of any Backcharge, after giving Subcontractor written notice of the Backcharge and its basis.
evidence.rationale: Section 8.1 allows backcharge setoff after written notice.

evidence.quote: Contractor may withhold from any payment an amount reasonably sufficient to cover the cost of correcting Subcontract Work that is defective or does not conform to the Subcontract Documents, until the defect or nonconformance is corrected.
evidence.rationale: Section 8.2 allows withholding for defective work. Section 8.3 adds withholding for claims and liens.

evidence.quote: Contractor will not pay for materials or equipment stored on or off the Project site that have not been incorporated into the Subcontract Work.
evidence.rationale: Section 5.5 expressly excludes payment for stored materials.

anomalies.description: Payment timing runs from Contractor's receipt of Owner payment. No outside date is stated by which Subcontractor must be paid if Owner never pays. Section 5.6 requires only notice and diligent pursuit when Owner withholds.

evidence.quote: the time for Contractor's payment to Subcontractor is measured from Contractor's receipt of the corresponding payment from Owner.
evidence.rationale: Payment timing runs from Contractor's receipt of Owner payment. No outside date is stated by which Subcontractor must be paid if Owner never pays. Section 5.6 requires only notice and diligent pursuit when Owner withholds.

anomalies.description: Retainage release depends on Contractor's receipt of retention from Owner in addition to Final Completion. Final Completion requires closeout deliverables to be "accepted by Contractor", which is a discretionary element.

evidence.quote: have been delivered to and accepted by Contractor.
evidence.rationale: Retainage release depends on Contractor's receipt of retention from Owner in addition to Final Completion. Final Completion requires closeout deliverables to be "accepted by Contractor", which is a discretionary element.

anomalies.description: Contractor may withhold the entire next progress payment until the prior unconditional waiver is delivered.

evidence.quote: Contractor may withhold the next progress payment until the unconditional waiver for the prior payment has been delivered.
evidence.rationale: Contractor may withhold the entire next progress payment until the prior unconditional waiver is delivered.

anomalies.description: A waiver not substantially following the NRS 108.2457 form makes the Application for Payment incomplete, which may delay payment timing.

evidence.quote: the related Application for Payment will be treated as incomplete until a conforming waiver is delivered.
evidence.rationale: A waiver not substantially following the NRS 108.2457 form makes the Application for Payment incomplete, which may delay payment timing.

anomalies.description: Long-lead items (panelboards, gymnasium lighting package) are paid only after installation. Subcontractor carries the cost and risk until then.

evidence.quote: Long-lead items such as panelboards and the gymnasium lighting package will be paid for only after installation.
evidence.rationale: Long-lead items (panelboards, gymnasium lighting package) are paid only after installation. Subcontractor carries the cost and risk until then.

anomalies.description: Change-order adjustments for Owner-originated changes are limited to what Contractor receives from Owner. This shifts Owner payment risk to Subcontractor for changes.

evidence.quote: Subcontractor's adjustments are limited to the extent Contractor receives a corresponding adjustment from Owner for changes originated by Owner.
evidence.rationale: Change-order adjustments for Owner-originated changes are limited to what Contractor receives from Owner. This shifts Owner payment risk to Subcontractor for changes.

anomalies.description: On Owner termination of the Prime Contract, Subcontractor's recovery is limited to its share of Contractor's recovery from Owner.

evidence.quote: Subcontractor's recovery shall be limited to its share of what Contractor recovers from Owner on Subcontractor's account.
evidence.rationale: On Owner termination of the Prime Contract, Subcontractor's recovery is limited to its share of Contractor's recovery from Owner.

anomalies.description: Section 8.3 gives broad additional withholding rights, including for claims or liens merely "reasonably expected".

evidence.quote: claims or liens filed or reasonably expected because of Subcontractor's acts or omissions
evidence.rationale: Section 8.3 gives broad additional withholding rights, including for claims or liens merely "reasonably expected".

anomalies.description: Acceptance of final payment waives all claims not previously made in writing and listed in the final payment application.

evidence.quote: Acceptance of final payment by Subcontractor constitutes a waiver of all claims by Subcontractor except those previously made in writing and identified as unsettled in Subcontractor's application for final payment.
evidence.rationale: Acceptance of final payment waives all claims not previously made in writing and listed in the final payment application.
